purpose: Run one fresh source-disjoint causal development test of Semantic-IR v2r2 with canonical uncapped TMax held fixed across direct, plan-control, and typed-treatment arms.

selected_claim.causal_variable: Typed source-to-semantic-to-target lowering with stable obligation and semantic-scope identities, explicit loss, actual target validation, and dependency-local repair.

single_mechanism_change.change_from_terminal_P4S: Normalize only unambiguous obligation-list delimiters before the unchanged strict lowerer; do not reinterpret or rescore P4S.

matched_arm_contract.only_treatment_difference: The semantic arm must express edits through stable v2r2 semantic units independently normalized, parsed, identity-checked, dependency-checked, lowered, validated, and locality-audited.

budgets.maximum_generation_tokens_semantics: Transport binding equal to the pinned model context window, not a quality or answer-length cap. Exact prompt tokens are subtracted and normal completion occurs on a complete artifact or model EOS.

decision_rule.development_survivor: The treatment is useful on at least four of ten tasks, solves at least three more tasks than each learned control and the prospective no-model compiler control, loses head-to-head on no more than one task against either learned control, has zero unsafe or rollback failures, meets every mechanics and custody floor, and is not dominated on joined model-call, token, verifier, latency, or rollback cost.
decision_rule.adequate_no_survivor: Every adequacy requirement passes but the development-survivor rule does not. This exact implementation is not advanced; no broader cognitive-compilation falsification follows.
decision_rule.inconclusive_implementation: Any treatment mechanics, parsing/lowering, intervention/locality, checkpoint-independent replay, or corruption floor fails.
decision_rule.inconclusive_experiment: Task diversity, matched resources, blind evaluation, source disjointness, uncertainty, weak-tail, or total-cost custody is incomplete.
decision_rule.uncertainty: Report all paired win/loss/tie tables, exact one-sided sign probabilities for non-tied treatment-versus-control outcomes, and task-level bootstrap intervals as descriptive development uncertainty; ten tasks cannot support a general population claim.
decision_rule.negative_scope: A null or loss applies only to this exact bounded Python Semantic-IR v2r2 implementation, frozen TMax model, ten-task distribution, completion policy, validator, and repair policy. It cannot falsify cognitive compilation generally.

D1_rule.surface: one prospectively frozen fresh source-disjoint D1 qualification denominator

hosted_reference.future_extension: Use identical frozen task membership and completion semantics with separately reported within-model denominators after a governed callable transport is source-bound.

maximum_inference: A terminal result can decide only whether this exact TMax plus Semantic-IR v2r2 implementation is a development survivor eligible for one fresh D1 qualification. It cannot establish general cognitive compilation, serving qualification, training eligibility, or ASI Stack book support.
